title: Code for "Conversational Zero Trust: Turning Social Engineering Detection into Access Decisions on Online Social Networks"
description: Code, frozen configuration, cached encoder outputs and the results file for the paper "Conversational Zero Trust: Turning Social Engineering Detection into Access Decisions on Online Social Networks" (submitted to IEEE Access). The pipeline combines two calibrated transformer encoders (SecureBERT and ModernBERT) and an 81-parameter fusion layer into a trust score, which a NIST SP 800-207 Policy Decision Point maps to Full Access, Restricted or Blocked. Every number reported in the paper is generated from results_v3_final.json.
